cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

mechanism: A maintains a confident organizing role by yielding attractive control and accepting B conditions so B will willingly take an unwanted task.
confusable: Distinguish a plain order or compliment from tailoring the job to B preferences enough to solicit volunteering; authority must adapt to keep the volunteer.
comparison: Wedding lettering trades copying and aunt friction for artistic choice; shed sorting trades A control of space for B trusted ownership.
seedUse: Canonical calligraphy and storage seeds have real B-driven concessions; S02 should be enacted in face-saving leadership around those concessions, not tacked to identical Drive speech.
